text: 中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见了高盛集团总裁兼首席运营官温泽恩，双方围绕全球经济金融形势、中国宏观经济政策等议题进行了交流。（中国央行网站）
text_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with Goldman Sachs President and Chief Operating Officer John Waldron, and the two sides exchanged views on topics including the global economic and financial situation and China's macroeconomic policies. (PBOC website)
